ko.title: 후보자 그 이상: 주 투표 부의 안건이 임금, 세금, 낙태 규정을 바꾸는 방법

segments.src: When voters head to the polls in the midterm elections, the names at the top of the ballot get most of the attention.
segments.tr: 유권자들이 중간선거에서 투표소로 향할 때, 투표 용지 상단에 있는 이름들이 가장 많은 관심을 받습니다.

segments.src: But further down the page, many Americans will also be asked to decide ballot questions that can reshape everyday life in ways a single congressional seat rarely can.
segments.tr: 하지만 페이지를 더 내려가 보면, 많은 미국인들은 단일 의회 의석으로는 거의 할 수 없는 방식으로 일상생활을 재편할 수 있는 투표 안건들에 결정을 내리도록 요청받게 됩니다.

segments.src: Ballot measures, also called initiatives, referendums or propositions, let voters weigh in directly on state laws and constitutions.
segments.tr: 주민발의, 주민투표 또는 법안(propositions)으로도 불리는 투표 부의 안건(Ballot measures)은 유권자가 주의 법률과 헌법에 직접 의사를 반영할 수 있게 합니다.

segments.src: Depending on the state, a measure may be placed on the ballot by citizen petition, by the legislature, or through a mix of both.
segments.tr: 주에 따라 안건은 시민 청원, 의회, 또는 두 가지의 혼합 방식을 통해 투표용지에 오를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If it passes, it can take effect without a governor's signature, and in some cases it changes the state constitution itself.
segments.tr: 통과될 경우 주지사의 서명 없이도 효력을 발휘할 수 있으며, 어떤 경우에는 주 헌법 자체를 바꾸기도 합니다.

segments.src: This guide explains why these measures matter, the main categories voters are likely to see, and how to prepare.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 이러한 안건이 왜 중요한지, 유권자들이 접하게 될 주요 범주, 그리고 어떻게 준비해야 하는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: Because the lineup differs from state to state and can change before Election Day, always confirm the exact wording and status of each measure with your state's official election office.
segments.tr: 안건 라인업은 주마다 다르며 선거일 전까지 변경될 수 있으므로, 항상 해당 주의 공식 선거 관리 사무소를 통해 각 안건의 정확한 문구와 상태를 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## Why ballot measures matter
segments.tr: ## 투표 부의 안건이 중요한 이유

segments.src: A member of Congress is one of 435 voices in the House, and one of many shaping federal policy.
segments.tr: 하원 의원은 하원의 435개 의석 중 하나이며, 연방 정책을 형성하는 많은 목소리 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, often decides a question outright.
segments.tr: 반면에 투표 부의 안건은 종종 사안을 즉각적으로 결정짓습니다.

segments.src: A yes or no vote can:
segments.tr: 찬성 또는 반대 투표는 다음과 같은 변화를 가져올 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - Change what an employer must pay a worker
segments.tr: - 고용주가 근로자에게 지급해야 하는 금액 변경

segments.src: - Alter how much residents owe in property, income or sales taxes
segments.tr: - 주민들이 납부해야 하는 재산세, 소득세 또는 영업세 금액 변경

segments.src: - Set the legal framework for health care decisions
segments.tr: - 의료 결정에 대한 법적 틀 마련

segments.src: - Rewrite the rules for how elections are run
segments.tr: - 선거 운영 방식에 대한 규칙 재작성

segments.src: Because the effects are direct and local, the results can be felt quickly, sometimes within a few months of the vote.
segments.tr: 영향력이 직접적이고 지역적이기 때문에, 결과는 때로는 투표 후 수개월 이내에 빠르게 체감될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Minimum wage and workplace rules
segments.tr: ## 최저임금 및 사업장 규칙

segments.src: Wage measures are among the most common citizen-driven questions.
segments.tr: 임금 안건은 시민 주도 안건 중 가장 흔한 유형에 속합니다.

segments.src: They typically ask voters to raise a state minimum wage to a set figure, often in steps over several years, or to tie future increases to inflation.
segments.tr: 보통 유권자에게 주의 최저임금을 정해진 수치로 인상하는 것(흔히 수년에 걸쳐 단계적으로)이나 향후 인상률을 물가상승률에 연동하는 것에 대해 묻습니다.

segments.src: Some measures also address paid sick leave, tipped-worker pay or scheduling rules.
segments.tr: 일부 안건은 유급 병가, 팁 근로자 임금 또는 근무 일정 규정을 다루기도 합니다.

segments.src: **What supporters usually argue:** Higher wage floors help workers keep up with rising living costs and reduce reliance on public assistance.
segments.tr: **찬성 측의 주요 주장:** 더 높은 임금 하한선은 근로자가 치솟는 물가를 감당하고 공적 구호에 대한 의존도를 줄이는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: **What opponents usually argue:** Higher labor costs can squeeze small businesses, leading to reduced hours, higher prices or fewer jobs, especially in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: **반대 측의 주요 주장:** 인건비 상승은 소상공인을 압박하여, 특히 물가가 낮은 지역에서 근무 시간 단축, 가격 인상 또는 일자리 감소로 이어질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **What to look for:** the final wage figure, the timeline for increases, whether future raises are automatic, and whether the measure includes exceptions for small employers or certain job types.
segments.tr: **확인해야 할 사항:** 최종 임금 수치, 인상 일정, 향후 인상이 자동인지 여부, 소규모 고용주나 특정 직종에 대한 예외 규정이 포함되어 있는지 여부.

segments.src: ## Taxes and public spending
segments.tr: ## 세금 및 공공 지출

segments.src: Tax questions come in many forms.
segments.tr: 세금 관련 안건은 다양한 형태로 출품됩니다.

segments.src: Voters may be asked to:
segments.tr: 유권자들은 다음과 같은 결정 요청을 받을 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - Raise or cut state income, property or sales taxes
segments.tr: - 주 소득세, 재산세 또는 영업세 인상 또는 인하

segments.src: - Approve bonds to fund schools, roads or housing
segments.tr: - 학교, 도로 또는 주택 재원을 마련하기 위한 채권 승인

segments.src: - Create or limit taxes on high earners
segments.tr: - 고소득자에 대한 세금 신설 또는 제한

segments.src: - Change how property is assessed
segments.tr: - 재산 평가 방식 변경

segments.src: - Set caps on government revenue or spending
segments.tr: - 정부 수입 또는 지출 상한선 설정

segments.src: These measures can be hard to read because the wording is technical.
segments.tr: 이러한 안건들은 전문적인 용어로 작성되어 읽기 어려울 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A few practical questions help cut through it: Who pays more or less?
segments.tr: 몇 가지 실용적인 질문을 통해 본질을 파악할 수 있습니다: 누가 세금을 더 내거나 적게 내는가?

segments.src: What will the money fund?
segments.tr: 그 돈은 어디에 사용되는가?

segments.src: Is the change temporary or permanent?
segments.tr: 이 변화는 한시적인가, 영구적인가?

segments.src: Nonpartisan fiscal analyses, which many states publish in official voter guides, usually estimate the cost or savings.
segments.tr: 많은 주에서 공식 유권자 가이드에 책자 형태로 발행하는 초당파적 재정 분석을 통해 보통 비용이나 절감액을 추정해 줍니다.

segments.src: ## Abortion and reproductive health
segments.tr: ## 낙태 및 생식 건강

segments.src: Since the U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: Supreme Court's 2022 decision in *Dobbs v.
segments.tr: 대법원의 2022년 *Dobbs v.

segments.src: Jackson Women's Health Organization* returned the question of abortion regulation to the states, voters in a number of states have been asked to decide the issue directly.
segments.tr: Jackson Women's Health Organization* 판결로 낙태 규제 권한이 각 주로 되돌아간 이후, 여러 주의 유권자들은 이 문제를 직접 결정하도록 요구받아 왔습니다.

segments.src: Some measures seek to add protections for abortion access to a state constitution.
segments.tr: 일부 안건은 주 헌법에 낙태 접근권에 대한 보호 조항을 추가하려 합니다.

segments.src: Others would preserve or add limits on when abortion is allowed.
segments.tr: 다른 안건들은 낙태가 허용되는 시기에 대한 제한을 유지하거나 추가하려 합니다.

segments.src: These are some of the most closely watched and emotionally charged measures on any ballot.
segments.tr: 이 사안들은 투표 용지에서 가장 주목받고 감정적으로 대립하는 안건 중 일부입니다.

segments.src: Because many are constitutional amendments, the outcome can set rules that are difficult to change later.
segments.tr: 많은 안건이 헌법 수정안이기 때문에, 결과에 따라 나중에 바꾸기 어려운 규칙이 제정될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Voters should read the full text carefully, since the legal definitions, such as the stage of pregnancy, exceptions for health or medical emergencies, and the role of state regulation, can differ significantly from one state to the next.
segments.tr: 임신 단계, 건강 또는 의학적 비상 상황에 대한 예외, 주 규제의 역할과 같은 법적 정의가 주마다 크게 다를 수 있으므로 유권자는 전체 전문을 주의 깊게 읽어야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Election rules and civic questions
segments.tr: ## 선거 규칙 및 시민사회 안건

segments.src: Another growing category involves how elections themselves work.
segments.tr: 또 다른 증가하는 범주는 선거 자체가 운영되는 방식과 관련이 있습니다.

segments.src: Examples that have appeared in various states include:
segments.tr: 여러 주에 등장한 예시들은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - Voter identification requirements
segments.tr: - 유권자 신원 확인(Voter ID) 요건

segments.src: - Ranked-choice voting
segments.tr: - 선호투표제 (Ranked-choice voting)

segments.src: - Open or nonpartisan primaries
segments.tr: - 개방형 또는 무당파 예비선거

segments.src: - How congressional or legislative districts are drawn
segments.tr: - 연방 의회 또는 주 의회 선거구 획정 방식

segments.src: - Rules for mail voting and early voting
segments.tr: - 우편 투표 및 사전 투표 규칙

segments.src: - Who is eligible to vote in local elections
segments.tr: - 지방 선거 투표 자격 요건

segments.src: - Changes to how the ballot initiative process works
segments.tr: - 주민발의 절차의 작동 방식 변경

segments.src: Because these measures affect the system through which future decisions are made, they can have long-lasting effects well beyond a single election.
segments.tr: 이러한 안건들은 향후 결정이 내려지는 시스템 자체에 영향을 미치기 때문에, 단 한 번의 선거를 넘어 장기적인 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Other issues that often appear
segments.tr: ## 자주 등장하는 기타 이슈

segments.src: Ballot questions can cover almost any area of state law.
segments.tr: 투표 안건은 주 법률의 거의 모든 분야를 다룰 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Voters in recent cycles have seen measures on topics such as:
segments.tr: 최근 선거에서 유권자들은 다음과 같은 주제의 안건들을 접했습니다:

segments.src: - Marijuana legalization or regulation
segments.tr: - 마리화나 합법화 또는 규제

segments.src: - Education funding and school choice
segments.tr: - 교육 재정 지원 및 학교 선택권

segments.src: - Healthcare access and insurance rules
segments.tr: - 의료 접근성 및 보험 규정

segments.src: - Housing and rent policy
segments.tr: - 주택 및 임대료 정책

segments.src: - Environmental and energy policy
segments.tr: - 환경 및 에너지 정책

segments.src: - Criminal justice reforms
segments.tr: - 형사 사법 개혁

segments.src: - Term limits and government ethics
segments.tr: - 임기 제한 및 공직자 윤리

segments.src: ## How to read a ballot measure like an informed voter
segments.tr: ## 현명한 유권자로서 투표 부의 안건을 읽는 방법

segments.src: Ballot language can be confusing, and a "yes" vote does not always mean what intuition suggests.
segments.tr: 투표용지의 문구는 혼란스러울 수 있으며, "찬성" 표가 항상 직관이 시사하는 바를 의미하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 습관이 도움이 될 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Read the official summary and full text.** Your state's secretary of state or election office publishes both.
segments.tr: 1. **공식 요약문과 전문을 읽으세요.** 해당 주의 국무장관 또는 선거 관리 사무소에서 두 가지 모두를 게시합니다.

segments.src: 2. **Check what a yes and a no vote actually do.** Some measures are written so that "yes" means keeping an existing law, while on others it means changing it.
segments.tr: 2. **찬성과 반대 투표가 실제로 의미하는 바를 확인하세요.** 일부 안건은 "찬성"이 기존 법률의 유지를 의미하는 반면, 다른 안건에서는 법률 변경을 의미하도록 작성됩니다.

segments.src: 3. **Look at the fiscal impact statement.** Nonpartisan analysts often estimate costs, savings or revenue effects.
segments.tr: 3. **재정 영향 평가서를 확인하세요.** 초당파 분석가들이 종종 비용, 절감액 또는 세수 효과를 추정합니다.

segments.src: 4. **Find out who is funding the campaigns.** Campaign finance records are public and show which groups back or oppose a measure.
segments.tr: 4. **캠페인 자금을 누굴 통해 조달하는지 알아보세요.** 선거 자금 기록은 공개되어 있으며 어떤 단체가 안건을 지지하거나 반대하는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: 5. **Compare several sources.** Reading local news coverage, nonpartisan voter guides and arguments from both sides gives a fuller picture than any one campaign message.
segments.tr: 5. **여러 출처를 비교하세요.** 지역 뉴스 보도, 초당파 유권자 가이드, 양측의 주장을 읽는 것이 단일 캠페인 메시지보다 더 완전한 그림을 제공합니다.

segments.src: 6. **Note whether it is a statute or a constitutional amendment.** Amendments are generally harder to undo.
segments.tr: 6. **일반 법률인지 헌법 수정안인지 확인하세요.** 헌법 수정안은 일반적으로 번복하기가 더 어렵습니다.

segments.src: 7. **Check the effective date.** Some measures take effect immediately; others phase in over years.
segments.tr: 7. **발효일을 확인하세요.** 일부 안건은 즉시 효력을 발휘하고, 다른 안건은 수년에 걸쳐 단계적으로 시행됩니다.

segments.src: ## Don't skip the bottom of the ballot
segments.tr: ## 투표용지 하단을 건너뛰지 마세요

segments.src: Studies of voting behavior have long shown that some voters stop filling out their ballots before they reach the ballot questions, a pattern known as "ballot roll-off."
segments.tr: 유권자 행태 연구에 따르면 일부 유권자들은 투표 부의 안건에 다다르기 전에 투표용지 기재를 중단하는 현상인 "투표 이탈(ballot roll-off)" 현상을 오랫동안 보여왔습니다.

segments.src: Yet these are often the places where a single vote has the most direct effect on policy.
segments.tr: 하지만 이 항목들이야말로 단 한 표가 정책에 가장 직접적인 영향을 미치는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Before you vote, find your state's official voter guide, confirm your polling place or early voting options, and consider reviewing a sample ballot, which many election offices post online.
segments.tr: 투표하기 전에 주의 공식 유권자 가이드를 찾고, 투표소 위치나 사전 투표 옵션을 확인하며, 많은 선거 관리 사무소가 온라인에 게시하는 샘플 투표용지를 검토해 보세요.

segments.src: A few minutes of preparation can make the difference between guessing and voting with confidence.
segments.tr: 몇 분의 준비가 어림짐작으로 투표하는 것과 확신을 가지고 투표하는 것의 차이를 만들어낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: Candidates matter, but so do the questions placed directly in voters' hands.
segments.tr: 후보자도 중요하지만, 유권자의 손에 직접 맡겨진 안건들도 중요합니다.

segments.src: Whether the topic is pay, taxes, health care or the mechanics of democracy itself, ballot measures give residents a say in the rules they live under.
segments.tr: 주제가 임금, 세금, 의료 또는 민주주의 메커니즘 자체이든 간에, 투표 부의 안건은 주민들에게 자신들이 적용받는 규칙에 대한 발언권을 부여합니다.

segments.src: Whatever your view, the most useful thing you can do is read the measure, understand what it would change, and make your choice.
segments.tr: 당신의 견해가 무엇이든, 할 수 있는 가장 유용한 일은 안건을 읽고, 그것이 무엇을 바꿀지 이해하며, 당신의 선택을 내리는 것입니다.

zh.title: 超越候选人：州公投议案将如何改变薪资、税收和堕胎规则

segments.src: When voters head to the polls in the midterm elections, the names at the top of the ballot get most of the attention.
segments.tr: 当选民在期中选举中前往投票站时，选票顶部的名字往往会受到最多的关注。

segments.src: But further down the page, many Americans will also be asked to decide ballot questions that can reshape everyday life in ways a single congressional seat rarely can.
segments.tr: 但在选票的下方，许多美国人还将面临决定公投议案的任务，这些议案能够以单个国会议席很少能做到的方式重塑日常生活。

segments.src: Ballot measures, also called initiatives, referendums or propositions, let voters weigh in directly on state laws and constitutions.
segments.tr: 公投议案（也称为民众提案、全民公决或修正案）让选民能够直接对州的法律和宪法发表意见。

segments.src: Depending on the state, a measure may be placed on the ballot by citizen petition, by the legislature, or through a mix of both.
segments.tr: 根据各州的不同，议案可以通过公民请愿、立法机关提出，或两者的结合而列入选票。

segments.src: If it passes, it can take effect without a governor's signature, and in some cases it changes the state constitution itself.
segments.tr: 如果获得通过，它可以在没有州长签字的情况下生效，在某些情况下，它甚至会改变州宪法本身。

segments.src: This guide explains why these measures matter, the main categories voters are likely to see, and how to prepare.
segments.tr: 本指南解释了这些议案的重要性、选民可能会看到的主要类别以及如何做好准备。

segments.src: Because the lineup differs from state to state and can change before Election Day, always confirm the exact wording and status of each measure with your state's official election office.
segments.tr: 由于各州的候选名单各不相同，且可能在选举日之前发生变化，请务必向您所在州的官方选举办公室确认每个议案的确切措辞和状态。

segments.src: ## Why ballot measures matter
segments.tr: ## 为什么公投议案很重要

segments.src: A member of Congress is one of 435 voices in the House, and one of many shaping federal policy.
segments.tr: 国会议员是众议院 435 个声音中的一个，也是塑造联邦政策的众多声音之一。

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, often decides a question outright.
segments.tr: 相比之下，公投议案通常直接决定一个问题。

segments.src: A yes or no vote can:
segments.tr: 投赞成票或反对票可以：

segments.src: - Change what an employer must pay a worker
segments.tr: - 改变雇主必须向工人支付的薪酬

segments.src: - Alter how much residents owe in property, income or sales taxes
segments.tr: - 改变居民在财产税、所得税或销售税上应缴纳的金额

segments.src: - Set the legal framework for health care decisions
segments.tr: - 为医疗保健决策制定法律框架

segments.src: - Rewrite the rules for how elections are run
segments.tr: - 重写选举运作规则

segments.src: Because the effects are direct and local, the results can be felt quickly, sometimes within a few months of the vote.
segments.tr: 由于影响是直接且局部的，因此结果可以很快感受到，有时在投票后几个月内就能感受到。

segments.src: ## Minimum wage and workplace rules
segments.tr: ## 最低工资与工作场所规则

segments.src: Wage measures are among the most common citizen-driven questions.
segments.tr: 薪资议案是公民发起的常见问题之一。

segments.src: They typically ask voters to raise a state minimum wage to a set figure, often in steps over several years, or to tie future increases to inflation.
segments.tr: 它们通常要求选民将州最低工资提高到设定的数字（通常在数年内分阶段实施），或者将未来的增长与通货膨胀挂钩。

segments.src: Some measures also address paid sick leave, tipped-worker pay or scheduling rules.
segments.tr: 一些议案还涉及带薪病假、小费工人工资或排班规则。

segments.src: **What supporters usually argue:** Higher wage floors help workers keep up with rising living costs and reduce reliance on public assistance.
segments.tr: **支持者通常的论点：** 更高的工资底线有助于工人赶上不断上涨的生活成本，并减少对公共援助的依赖。

segments.src: **What opponents usually argue:** Higher labor costs can squeeze small businesses, leading to reduced hours, higher prices or fewer jobs, especially in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: **反对者通常的论点：** 更高的劳动力成本可能会挤压小企业，导致工时减少、价格上涨或工作岗位减少，尤其是在生活成本较低的地区。

segments.src: **What to look for:** the final wage figure, the timeline for increases, whether future raises are automatic, and whether the measure includes exceptions for small employers or certain job types.
segments.tr: **寻找的重点：** 最终的薪资数字、加薪时间表、未来的加薪是否自动生效，以及该议案是否包含对小雇主或特定工作类型的例外规定。

segments.src: ## Taxes and public spending
segments.tr: ## 税收与公共支出

segments.src: Tax questions come in many forms.
segments.tr: 税收问题有多种形式。

segments.src: Voters may be asked to:
segments.tr: 可能会要求选民：

segments.src: - Raise or cut state income, property or sales taxes
segments.tr: - 提高或削减州所得税、财产税或销售税

segments.src: - Approve bonds to fund schools, roads or housing
segments.tr: - 批准债券以资助学校、道路或住房

segments.src: - Create or limit taxes on high earners
segments.tr: - 创建或限制对高收入者的征税

segments.src: - Change how property is assessed
segments.tr: - 改变财产评估方式

segments.src: - Set caps on government revenue or spending
segments.tr: - 对政府收入或支出设定上限

segments.src: These measures can be hard to read because the wording is technical.
segments.tr: 这些议案可能很难阅读，因为措辞很专业。

segments.src: A few practical questions help cut through it: Who pays more or less?
segments.tr: 几个实际问题有助于理清头绪：谁支付更多或更少？

segments.src: What will the money fund?
segments.tr: 这些资金将用于资助什么？

segments.src: Is the change temporary or permanent?
segments.tr: 这种变更是暂时的还是永久的？

segments.src: Nonpartisan fiscal analyses, which many states publish in official voter guides, usually estimate the cost or savings.
segments.tr: 许多州在官方选民指南中发布的无党派财政分析通常会估算成本或节省额。

segments.src: ## Abortion and reproductive health
segments.tr: ## 堕胎与生殖健康

segments.src: Since the U.S.
segments.tr: 自从美国

segments.src: Supreme Court's 2022 decision in *Dobbs v.
segments.tr: 最高法院在 2022 年对 *Dobbs v.

segments.src: Jackson Women's Health Organization* returned the question of abortion regulation to the states, voters in a number of states have been asked to decide the issue directly.
segments.tr: Jackson Women's Health Organization* 一案的裁决将堕胎监管问题交还给各州以来，多个州的选民被要求直接决定这一问题。

segments.src: Some measures seek to add protections for abortion access to a state constitution.
segments.tr: 一些议案试图将堕胎服务的保护措施加入州宪法。

segments.src: Others would preserve or add limits on when abortion is allowed.
segments.tr: 另一些议案则旨在保留或增加对允许堕胎时间的限制。

segments.src: These are some of the most closely watched and emotionally charged measures on any ballot.
segments.tr: 这些是任何选票上最受关注且充满情感色彩的议案之一。

segments.src: Because many are constitutional amendments, the outcome can set rules that are difficult to change later.
segments.tr: 由于许多议案是宪法修正案，其结果可能会制定出以后很难更改的规则。

segments.src: Voters should read the full text carefully, since the legal definitions, such as the stage of pregnancy, exceptions for health or medical emergencies, and the role of state regulation, can differ significantly from one state to the next.
segments.tr: 选民应仔细阅读全文，因为法律定义（例如怀孕阶段、健康或医疗紧急情况的例外情况以及州监管的作用）在不同州之间可能存在显著差异。

segments.src: ## Election rules and civic questions
segments.tr: ## 选举规则与公民问题

segments.src: Another growing category involves how elections themselves work.
segments.tr: 另一个不断增长的类别涉及选举本身的运作方式。

segments.src: Examples that have appeared in various states include:
segments.tr: 在各州出现的例子包括：

segments.src: - Voter identification requirements
segments.tr: - 选民身份验证要求

segments.src: - Ranked-choice voting
segments.tr: - 排序选择投票法

segments.src: - Open or nonpartisan primaries
segments.tr: - 开放式或无党派初选

segments.src: - How congressional or legislative districts are drawn
segments.tr: - 国会或立法选区的划分方式

segments.src: - Rules for mail voting and early voting
segments.tr: - 邮寄投票和提前投票的规则

segments.src: - Who is eligible to vote in local elections
segments.tr: - 谁有资格在地方选举中投票

segments.src: - Changes to how the ballot initiative process works
segments.tr: - 对公投提案运作方式的更改

segments.src: Because these measures affect the system through which future decisions are made, they can have long-lasting effects well beyond a single election.
segments.tr: 由于这些议案影响了未来做出决策的系统，它们可以产生远远超出单次选举的长远影响。

segments.src: ## Other issues that often appear
segments.tr: ## 经常出现的其他问题

segments.src: Ballot questions can cover almost any area of state law.
segments.tr: 公投问题几乎可以涵盖州法的任何领域。

segments.src: Voters in recent cycles have seen measures on topics such as:
segments.tr: 在最近的周期中，选民看到了关于以下主题的议案：

segments.src: - Marijuana legalization or regulation
segments.tr: - 大麻合法化或监管

segments.src: - Education funding and school choice
segments.tr: - 教育资金与学校选择

segments.src: - Healthcare access and insurance rules
segments.tr: - 医疗保健获取与保险规则

segments.src: - Housing and rent policy
segments.tr: - 住房与租金政策

segments.src: - Environmental and energy policy
segments.tr: - 环境与能源政策

segments.src: - Criminal justice reforms
segments.tr: - 刑事司法改革

segments.src: - Term limits and government ethics
segments.tr: - 任期限制与政府道德

segments.src: ## How to read a ballot measure like an informed voter
segments.tr: ## 如何像一个理智的选民一样阅读公投议案

segments.src: Ballot language can be confusing, and a "yes" vote does not always mean what intuition suggests.
segments.tr: 选票上的语言可能会令人困惑，“赞成”票并不总是意味着直觉所暗示的意思。

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: 几个习惯会有所帮助：

segments.src: 1. **Read the official summary and full text.** Your state's secretary of state or election office publishes both.
segments.tr: 1. **阅读官方摘要和全文。** 您所在州的州务卿或选举办公室会发布这两者。

segments.src: 2. **Check what a yes and a no vote actually do.** Some measures are written so that "yes" means keeping an existing law, while on others it means changing it.
segments.tr: 2. **检查赞成票和反对票的实际作用。** 有些议案的编写使得“赞成”意味着保留现有法律，而另一些则意味着对其进行更改。

segments.src: 3. **Look at the fiscal impact statement.** Nonpartisan analysts often estimate costs, savings or revenue effects.
segments.tr: 3. **查看财政影响声明。** 无党派分析师通常会估计成本、节省额或收入影响。

segments.src: 4. **Find out who is funding the campaigns.** Campaign finance records are public and show which groups back or oppose a measure.
segments.tr: 4. **弄清楚是谁在资助竞选活动。** 竞选财务记录是公开的，显示了哪些团体支持或反对某项议案。

segments.src: 5. **Compare several sources.** Reading local news coverage, nonpartisan voter guides and arguments from both sides gives a fuller picture than any one campaign message.
segments.tr: 5. **比较多个来源。** 阅读当地新闻报道、无党派选民指南以及双方的辩论，比任何单一的竞选信息都能提供更全面的图景。

segments.src: 6. **Note whether it is a statute or a constitutional amendment.** Amendments are generally harder to undo.
segments.tr: 6. **注意它是成文法还是宪法修正案。** 修正案通常更难推翻。

segments.src: 7. **Check the effective date.** Some measures take effect immediately; others phase in over years.
segments.tr: 7. **检查生效日期。** 一些议案立即生效；另一些则在几年内分阶段实施。

segments.src: ## Don't skip the bottom of the ballot
segments.tr: ## 不要跳过选票底部

segments.src: Studies of voting behavior have long shown that some voters stop filling out their ballots before they reach the ballot questions, a pattern known as "ballot roll-off."
segments.tr: 对投票行为的研究长期表明，一些选民在触及公投问题之前就停止填写选票，这种模式被称为“选票流失”。

segments.src: Yet these are often the places where a single vote has the most direct effect on policy.
segments.tr: 然而，这些往往是单张选票对政策产生最直接影响的地方。

segments.src: Before you vote, find your state's official voter guide, confirm your polling place or early voting options, and consider reviewing a sample ballot, which many election offices post online.
segments.tr: 在您投票之前，请找到您所在州的官方选民指南，确认您的投票站或提前投票选项，并考虑查看许多选举办公室在线发布的样本选票。

segments.src: A few minutes of preparation can make the difference between guessing and voting with confidence.
segments.tr: 几分钟的准备就能带来猜测与自信投票之间的区别。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Candidates matter, but so do the questions placed directly in voters' hands.
segments.tr: 候选人很重要，但直接交到选民手中的问题也同样重要。

segments.src: Whether the topic is pay, taxes, health care or the mechanics of democracy itself, ballot measures give residents a say in the rules they live under.
segments.tr: 无论主题是薪酬、税收、医疗保健还是民主机制本身，公投议案都让居民对他们所处的生活规则拥有发言权。

segments.src: Whatever your view, the most useful thing you can do is read the measure, understand what it would change, and make your choice.
segments.tr: 无论您的观点如何，您能做的最有用的事情就是阅读议案，理解它将改变什么，并做出您的选择。

segments.src: *This article is intended for general informational purposes and does not endorse any candidate, measure or position.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，不背书任何候选人、议案或立场。

segments.src: Ballot contents and details vary by state and may change; verify all information with your state or local election office.*
segments.tr: 选票内容和细节因州而异，且可能会发生变化；请与您所在州或地方选举办公室核实所有信息。*

segments.src: ## Why ballot measures matter
segments.tr: ## जनमत संग्रह क्यों महत्वपूर्ण हैं

segments.src: A member of Congress is one of 435 voices in the House, and one of many shaping federal policy.

segments.src: A yes or no vote can:
segments.tr: हाँ या ना में दिया गया वोट यह कर सकता है:

segments.src: - Change what an employer must pay a worker
segments.tr: - बदलें कि एक नियोक्ता को श्रमिक को क्या भुगतान करना चाहिए

segments.src: - Alter how much residents owe in property, income or sales taxes
segments.tr: - बदलें कि निवासी संपत्ति, आय या बिक्री करों में कितना भुगतान करते हैं

segments.src: - Set the legal framework for health care decisions
segments.tr: - स्वास्थ्य देखभाल निर्णयों के लिए कानूनी ढांचा स्थापित करें

segments.src: - Rewrite the rules for how elections are run
segments.tr: - चुनाव कैसे आयोजित किए जाते हैं, इसके नियमों को फिर से लिखें

segments.src: Because the effects are direct and local, the results can be felt quickly, sometimes within a few months of the vote.
segments.tr: चूंकि प्रभाव प्रत्यक्ष और स्थानीय होते हैं, इसलिए परिणामों को जल्दी महसूस किया जा सकता है, कभी-कभी मतदान के कुछ महीनों के भीतर।

segments.src: ## Minimum wage and workplace rules
segments.tr: ## न्यूनतम मजदूरी और कार्यस्थल के नियम

segments.src: Wage measures are among the most common citizen-driven questions.
segments.tr: मजदूरी से जुड़े प्रस्ताव सबसे आम नागरिक-संचालित प्रश्नों में से हैं।

segments.src: They typically ask voters to raise a state minimum wage to a set figure, often in steps over several years, or to tie future increases to inflation.
segments.tr: वे आमतौर पर मतदाताओं से राज्य के न्यूनतम वेतन को एक निश्चित आंकड़े तक बढ़ाने के लिए कहते हैं, अक्सर कई वर्षों में चरणों में, या भविष्य की वृद्धि को मुद्रास्फीति से जोड़ने के लिए कहते हैं।

segments.src: Some measures also address paid sick leave, tipped-worker pay or scheduling rules.
segments.tr: कुछ प्रस्ताव भुगतान किए जाने वाले बीमार अवकाश, टिप पाने वाले कर्मचारियों के वेतन या शेड्यूलिंग नियमों को भी संबोधित करते हैं।

segments.src: **What supporters usually argue:** Higher wage floors help workers keep up with rising living costs and reduce reliance on public assistance.
segments.tr: **समर्थक आमतौर पर क्या तर्क देते हैं:** उच्च मजदूरी के स्तर श्रमिकों को बढ़ती जीवन लागत के साथ तालमेल बिठाने में मदद करते हैं और सार्वजनिक सहायता पर निर्भरता को कम करते हैं।

segments.src: **What opponents usually argue:** Higher labor costs can squeeze small businesses, leading to reduced hours, higher prices or fewer jobs, especially in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: **विरोधी आमतौर पर क्या तर्क देते हैं:** उच्च श्रम लागत छोटे व्यवसायों पर दबाव डाल सकती है, जिससे कम घंटे, उच्च कीमतें या कम नौकरियां हो सकती हैं, विशेष रूप से कम लागत वाले क्षेत्रों में।

segments.src: **What to look for:** the final wage figure, the timeline for increases, whether future raises are automatic, and whether the measure includes exceptions for small employers or certain job types.
segments.tr: **क्या देखें:** अंतिम मजदूरी का आंकड़ा, वृद्धि के लिए समयरेखा, क्या भविष्य की वृद्धि स्वतः होती है, और क्या प्रस्ताव में छोटे नियोक्ताओं या कुछ नौकरी के प्रकारों के लिए अपवाद शामिल हैं।

segments.src: ## Taxes and public spending
segments.tr: ## कर और सार्वजनिक खर्च

segments.src: Tax questions come in many forms.
segments.tr: कर के प्रश्न कई रूपों में आते हैं।

segments.src: Voters may be asked to:
segments.tr: मतदाताओं से यह पूछा जा सकता है:

segments.src: - Raise or cut state income, property or sales taxes
segments.tr: - राज्य की आय, संपत्ति या बिक्री करों को बढ़ाना या घटाना

segments.src: - Approve bonds to fund schools, roads or housing
segments.tr: - स्कूलों, सड़कों या आवास को निधि देने के लिए बॉंड स्वीकृत करना

segments.src: - Create or limit taxes on high earners
segments.tr: - अधिक कमाने वालों पर कर बनाना या सीमित करना

segments.src: - Change how property is assessed
segments.tr: - संपत्ति का आकलन कैसे किया जाता है, इसे बदलना

segments.src: - Set caps on government revenue or spending
segments.tr: - सरकारी राजस्व या खर्च पर सीमाएं निर्धारित करना

segments.src: These measures can be hard to read because the wording is technical.
segments.tr: इन प्रस्तावों को पढ़ना कठिन हो सकता है क्योंकि शब्दावली तकनीकी होती है।

segments.src: A few practical questions help cut through it: Who pays more or less?
segments.tr: कुछ व्यावहारिक प्रश्न इसे समझने में मदद करते हैं: कौन अधिक या कम भुगतान करता है?

segments.src: What will the money fund?
segments.tr: धन का उपयोग कहाँ किया जाएगा?

segments.src: Is the change temporary or permanent?
segments.tr: क्या परिवर्तन अस्थायी है या स्थायी?

segments.src: Nonpartisan fiscal analyses, which many states publish in official voter guides, usually estimate the cost or savings.
segments.tr: गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण राजकोषीय विश्लेषण, जिन्हें कई राज्य आधिकारिक मतदाता मार्गदर्शिकाओं में प्रकाशित करते हैं, आमतौर पर लागत या बचत का अनुमान लगाते हैं।

segments.src: ## Abortion and reproductive health
segments.tr: ## गर्भपात और प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य

segments.src: Since the U.S.
segments.tr: चूंकि अमेरिकी

segments.src: Supreme Court's 2022 decision in *Dobbs v.
segments.tr: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के 2022 के फैसले *डॉब्स बनाम

segments.src: Jackson Women's Health Organization* returned the question of abortion regulation to the states, voters in a number of states have been asked to decide the issue directly.
segments.tr: जैक्सन विमेंस हेल्थ ऑर्गनाइजेशन* ने राज्यों को गर्भपात के विनियमन का सवाल वापस सौंप दिया, कई राज्यों में मतदाताओं से इस मुद्दे पर सीधे निर्णय लेने के लिए कहा गया है।

segments.src: Some measures seek to add protections for abortion access to a state constitution.
segments.tr: कुछ प्रस्ताव राज्य के संविधान में गर्भपात तक पहुंच के लिए सुरक्षा जोड़ने की मांग करते हैं।

segments.src: Others would preserve or add limits on when abortion is allowed.
segments.tr: अन्य लोग इस बात पर सीमाएं बनाए रखेंगे या जोड़ेंगे कि गर्भपात की अनुमति कब है।

segments.src: These are some of the most closely watched and emotionally charged measures on any ballot.
segments.tr: ये किसी भी मतपत्र पर सबसे अधिक देखे जाने वाले और भावनात्मक रूप से आवेशित प्रस्तावों में से हैं।

segments.src: Because many are constitutional amendments, the outcome can set rules that are difficult to change later.
segments.tr: चूंकि कई संवैधानिक संशोधन हैं, इसलिए परिणाम ऐसे नियम तय कर सकते हैं जिन्हें बाद में बदलना मुश्किल है।

segments.src: Voters should read the full text carefully, since the legal definitions, such as the stage of pregnancy, exceptions for health or medical emergencies, and the role of state regulation, can differ significantly from one state to the next.
segments.tr: मतदाताओं को पूर्ण पाठ को ध्यान से पढ़ना चाहिए, क्योंकि कानूनी परिभाषाएं, जैसे गर्भावस्था का चरण, स्वास्थ्य या चिकित्सा आपात स्थितियों के लिए अपवाद, और राज्य विनियमन की भूमिका, एक राज्य से दूसरे राज्य में काफी भिन्न हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## Election rules and civic questions
segments.tr: ## चुनाव नियम और नागरिक प्रश्न

segments.src: Another growing category involves how elections themselves work.
segments.tr: एक अन्य बढ़ती हुई श्रेणी में यह शामिल है कि चुनाव खुद कैसे काम करते हैं।

segments.src: Examples that have appeared in various states include:
segments.tr: विभिन्न राज्यों में दिखाई देने वाले उदाहरणों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - Voter identification requirements
segments.tr: - मतदाता पहचान आवश्यकताएँ

segments.src: - Ranked-choice voting
segments.tr: - रैंक-पसंद मतदान

segments.src: - Open or nonpartisan primaries
segments.tr: - खुले या गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण प्राथमिक चुनाव

segments.src: - How congressional or legislative districts are drawn
segments.tr: - कांग्रेस या विधायी जिलों को कैसे खींचा जाता है

segments.src: - Rules for mail voting and early voting
segments.tr: - मेल मतदान और प्रारंभिक मतदान के लिए नियम

segments.src: - Who is eligible to vote in local elections
segments.tr: - स्थानीय चुनावों में मतदान करने के लिए कौन पात्र है

segments.src: - Changes to how the ballot initiative process works
segments.tr: - मतपत्र पहल प्रक्रिया कैसे काम करती है, इसमें परिवर्तन

segments.src: Because these measures affect the system through which future decisions are made, they can have long-lasting effects well beyond a single election.
segments.tr: चूंकि ये प्रस्ताव उस प्रणाली को प्रभावित करते हैं जिसके माध्यम से भविष्य के निर्णय लिए जाते हैं, इसलिए एकल चुनाव से परे उनके लंबे समय तक चलने वाले प्रभाव हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Other issues that often appear
segments.tr: ## अन्य मुद्दे जो अक्सर सामने आते हैं

segments.src: Ballot questions can cover almost any area of state law.
segments.tr: मतपत्र के प्रश्न राज्य के कानून के लगभग किसी भी क्षेत्र को कवर कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Voters in recent cycles have seen measures on topics such as:
segments.tr: हाल के चक्रों में मतदाताओं ने ऐसे विषयों पर प्रस्ताव देखे हैं जैसे:

segments.src: - Marijuana legalization or regulation
segments.tr: - मारिजुआना का वैधीकरण या विनियमन

segments.src: - Education funding and school choice
segments.tr: - शिक्षा वित्त पोषण और स्कूल विकल्प

segments.src: - Healthcare access and insurance rules
segments.tr: - स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पहुंच और बीमा नियम

segments.src: - Housing and rent policy
segments.tr: - आवास और किराया नीति

segments.src: - Environmental and energy policy
segments.tr: - पर्यावरण और ऊर्जा नीति

segments.src: - Criminal justice reforms
segments.tr: - आपराधिक न्याय सुधार

segments.src: - Term limits and government ethics
segments.tr: - कार्यकाल की सीमा और सरकारी नैतिकता

segments.src: ## How to read a ballot measure like an informed voter
segments.tr: ## एक सूचित मतदाता की तरह मतपत्र प्रस्ताव को कैसे पढ़ें

segments.src: Ballot language can be confusing, and a "yes" vote does not always mean what intuition suggests.
segments.tr: मतपत्र की भाषा भ्रमित करने वाली हो सकती है, और "हाँ" वोट का मतलब हमेशा वह नहीं होता जो अंतर्ज्ञान सुझाता है।

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: कुछ आदतें मदद करती हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Read the official summary and full text.** Your state's secretary of state or election office publishes both.
segments.tr: 1. **आधिकारिक सारांश और पूर्ण पाठ पढ़ें।** आपके राज्य का सेक्रेटरी ऑफ़ स्टेट या चुनाव कार्यालय दोनों प्रकाशित करता है।

segments.src: 2. **Check what a yes and a no vote actually do.** Some measures are written so that "yes" means keeping an existing law, while on others it means changing it.
segments.tr: 2. **जांचें कि हाँ और ना वोट वास्तव में क्या करते हैं।** कुछ प्रस्ताव इस तरह लिखे गए हैं कि "हाँ" का अर्थ मौजूदा कानून को बनाए रखना है, जबकि अन्य पर इसका मतलब इसे बदलना है।

segments.src: 3. **Look at the fiscal impact statement.** Nonpartisan analysts often estimate costs, savings or revenue effects.
segments.tr: 3. **राजकोषीय प्रभाव विवरण को देखें।** गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण विश्लेषक अक्सर लागत, बचत या राजस्व प्रभावों का अनुमान लगाते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Find out who is funding the campaigns.** Campaign finance records are public and show which groups back or oppose a measure.
segments.tr: 4. **पता लगाएं कि अभियानों को कौन वित्त पोषण दे रहा है।** अभियान वित्त रिकॉर्ड सार्वजनिक हैं और दिखाते हैं कि कौन से समूह किसी प्रस्ताव का समर्थन या विरोध करते हैं।

segments.src: 5. **Compare several sources.** Reading local news coverage, nonpartisan voter guides and arguments from both sides gives a fuller picture than any one campaign message.
segments.tr: 5. **कई स्रोतों की तुलना करें।** स्थानीय समाचार कवरेज, गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण मतदाता मार्गदर्शिकाएँ और दोनों पक्षों के तर्कों को पढ़ना किसी भी एक अभियान संदेश की तुलना में अधिक संपूर्ण चित्र देता है।

segments.src: 6. **Note whether it is a statute or a constitutional amendment.** Amendments are generally harder to undo.
segments.tr: 6. **ध्यान दें कि यह एक कानून है या संवैधानिक संशोधन।** संशोधनों को उलटना आम तौर पर कठिन होता है।

segments.src: 7. **Check the effective date.** Some measures take effect immediately; others phase in over years.
segments.tr: 7. **प्रभावी तिथि की जांच करें।** कुछ प्रस्ताव तुरंत प्रभावी होते हैं; अन्य वर्षों में चरणबद्ध तरीके से लागू होते हैं।

segments.src: ## Don't skip the bottom of the ballot
segments.tr: ## मतपत्र के नीचे के हिस्से को न छोड़ें

segments.src: Studies of voting behavior have long shown that some voters stop filling out their ballots before they reach the ballot questions, a pattern known as "ballot roll-off."
segments.tr: मतदान के व्यवहार के अध्ययन लंबे समय से दिखाते रहे हैं कि कुछ मतदाता मतपत्र के प्रश्नों तक पहुँचने से पहले ही अपने मतपत्रों को भरना बंद कर देते हैं, एक ऐसा पैटर्न जिसे "बैलट रोल-ऑफ़" कहा जाता है।

segments.src: Yet these are often the places where a single vote has the most direct effect on policy.
segments.tr: फिर भी ये अक्सर ऐसी जगहें होती हैं जहाँ एक ही वोट का नीति पर सबसे प्रत्यक्ष प्रभाव पड़ता है।

segments.src: Before you vote, find your state's official voter guide, confirm your polling place or early voting options, and consider reviewing a sample ballot, which many election offices post online.
segments.tr: मतदान करने से पहले, अपने राज्य की आधिकारिक मतदाता मार्गदर्शिका खोजें, अपने मतदान केंद्र या शुरुआती मतदान विकल्पों की पुष्टि करें, और एक नमूना मतपत्र की समीक्षा करने पर विचार करें, जिसे कई चुनाव कार्यालय ऑनलाइन पोस्ट करते हैं।

segments.src: A few minutes of preparation can make the difference between guessing and voting with confidence.
segments.tr: कुछ मिनटों की तैयारी अनुमान लगाने और आत्मविश्वास के साथ मतदान करने के बीच का अंतर पैदा कर सकती है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Candidates matter, but so do the questions placed directly in voters' hands.
segments.tr: उम्मीदवार मायने रखते हैं, लेकिन सीधे मतदाताओं के हाथों में रखे गए प्रश्न भी उतना ही मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: Whether the topic is pay, taxes, health care or the mechanics of democracy itself, ballot measures give residents a say in the rules they live under.
segments.tr: चाहे विषय वेतन, कर, स्वास्थ्य देखभाल या लोकतंत्र की यांत्रिकी हो, मतपत्र प्रस्ताव निवासियों को उन नियमों पर अपनी बात रखने का अधिकार देते हैं जिनके तहत वे जीते हैं।

segments.src: Whatever your view, the most useful thing you can do is read the measure, understand what it would change, and make your choice.
segments.tr: आपका जो भी दृष्टिकोण हो, सबसे उपयोगी काम जो आप कर सकते हैं वह है प्रस्ताव को पढ़ना, यह समझना कि यह क्या बदलेगा, और अपनी पसंद बनाना।

segments.src: *This article is intended for general informational purposes and does not endorse any candidate, measure or position.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य सूचना के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और किसी भी उम्मीदवार, प्रस्ताव या स्थिति का समर्थन नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Ballot contents and details vary by state and may change; verify all information with your state or local election office.*
segments.tr: मतपत्र की सामग्री और विवरण राज्य के अनुसार अलग-अलग होते हैं और बदल सकते हैं; अपने राज्य या स्थानीय चुनाव कार्यालय से सभी जानकारी की पुष्टि करें।*

es.title: Más allá de los candidatos: cómo las medidas electorales estatales podrían cambiar los salarios, los impuestos y las normas sobre el aborto

segments.src: When voters head to the polls in the midterm elections, the names at the top of the ballot get most of the attention.
segments.tr: Cuando los votantes acuden a las urnas en las elecciones de mitad de periodo, los nombres en la parte superior de la papeleta reciben la mayor parte de la atención.

segments.src: But further down the page, many Americans will also be asked to decide ballot questions that can reshape everyday life in ways a single congressional seat rarely can.
segments.tr: Pero más abajo en la página, a muchos estadounidenses también se les pedirá que decidan sobre preguntas de la papeleta que pueden redefinir la vida cotidiana de formas que un único escaño en el Congreso rara vez puede.

segments.src: Ballot measures, also called initiatives, referendums or propositions, let voters weigh in directly on state laws and constitutions.
segments.tr: Las medidas electorales, también llamadas iniciativas, referendos o proposiciones, permiten a los votantes opinar directamente sobre las leyes y constituciones estatales.

segments.src: Depending on the state, a measure may be placed on the ballot by citizen petition, by the legislature, or through a mix of both.
segments.tr: Dependiendo del estado, una medida puede incluirse en la papeleta mediante una petición ciudadana, por la legislatura o a través de una combinación de ambas.

segments.src: If it passes, it can take effect without a governor's signature, and in some cases it changes the state constitution itself.
segments.tr: Si se aprueba, puede entrar en vigor sin la firma de un gobernador y, en algunos casos, cambia la propia constitución estatal.

segments.src: This guide explains why these measures matter, the main categories voters are likely to see, and how to prepare.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica por qué importan estas medidas, las principales categorías que los votantes probablemente verán y cómo prepararse.

segments.src: Because the lineup differs from state to state and can change before Election Day, always confirm the exact wording and status of each measure with your state's official election office.
segments.tr: Debido a que la lista difiere de un estado a otro y puede cambiar antes del día de las elecciones, confirme siempre la redacción exacta y el estado de cada medida con la oficina electoral oficial de su estado.

segments.src: ## Why ballot measures matter
segments.tr: ## Por qué importan las medidas electorales

segments.src: A member of Congress is one of 435 voices in the House, and one of many shaping federal policy.
segments.tr: Un miembro del Congreso es una de las 435 voces en la Cámara de Representantes y una de muchas que moldean la política federal.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, often decides a question outright.
segments.tr: Una medida electoral, por el contrario, a menudo decide una cuestión de forma directa.

segments.src: A yes or no vote can:
segments.tr: Un voto a favor o en contra puede:

segments.src: - Change what an employer must pay a worker
segments.tr: - Cambiar lo que un empleador debe pagar a un trabajador

segments.src: - Alter how much residents owe in property, income or sales taxes
segments.tr: - Alterar cuánto deben los residentes en impuestos sobre la propiedad, la renta o las ventas

segments.src: - Set the legal framework for health care decisions
segments.tr: - Establecer el marco legal para las decisiones de atención médica

segments.src: - Rewrite the rules for how elections are run
segments.tr: - Reescribir las reglas sobre cómo se llevan a cabo las elecciones

segments.src: Because the effects are direct and local, the results can be felt quickly, sometimes within a few months of the vote.
segments.tr: Debido a que los efectos son directos y locales, los resultados se pueden sentir rápidamente, a veces en pocos meses desde la votación.

segments.src: ## Minimum wage and workplace rules
segments.tr: ## Salario mínimo y normas del lugar de trabajo

segments.src: Wage measures are among the most common citizen-driven questions.
segments.tr: Las medidas salariales se encuentran entre las preguntas impulsadas por los ciudadanos más comunes.

segments.src: They typically ask voters to raise a state minimum wage to a set figure, often in steps over several years, or to tie future increases to inflation.
segments.tr: Por lo general, piden a los votantes que aumenten el salario mínimo estatal a una cifra determinada, a menudo de forma gradual durante varios años, o que vinculen los futuros aumentos a la inflación.

segments.src: Some measures also address paid sick leave, tipped-worker pay or scheduling rules.
segments.tr: Algunas medidas también abordan la licencia por enfermedad pagada, el pago a trabajadores que reciben propinas o las normas de horarios.

segments.src: **What supporters usually argue:** Higher wage floors help workers keep up with rising living costs and reduce reliance on public assistance.
segments.tr: **Lo que los partidarios suelen argumentar:** Unos salarios mínimos más altos ayudan a los trabajadores a hacer frente al aumento del costo de vida y reducen la dependencia de la asistencia pública.

segments.src: **What opponents usually argue:** Higher labor costs can squeeze small businesses, leading to reduced hours, higher prices or fewer jobs, especially in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: **Lo que los opositores suelen argumentar:** Unos costos laborales más altos pueden presionar a las pequeñas empresas, lo que lleva a una reducción de horas, precios más altos o menos empleos, especialmente en regiones de menor costo.

segments.src: **What to look for:** the final wage figure, the timeline for increases, whether future raises are automatic, and whether the measure includes exceptions for small employers or certain job types.
segments.tr: **Qué buscar:** la cifra salarial final, el cronograma de aumentos, si los futuros aumentos son automáticos y si la medida incluye excepciones para pequeños empleadores o ciertos tipos de trabajo.

segments.src: ## Taxes and public spending
segments.tr: ## Impuestos y gasto público

segments.src: Tax questions come in many forms.
segments.tr: Las preguntas sobre impuestos se presentan de muchas formas.

segments.src: Voters may be asked to:
segments.tr: Se les puede pedir a los votantes que:

segments.src: - Raise or cut state income, property or sales taxes
segments.tr: - Aumenten o reduzcan los impuestos estatales sobre la renta, la propiedad o las ventas

segments.src: - Approve bonds to fund schools, roads or housing
segments.tr: - Aprueben bonos para financiar escuelas, carreteras o viviendas

segments.src: - Create or limit taxes on high earners
segments.tr: - Creen o limiten impuestos a los de mayores ingresos

segments.src: - Change how property is assessed
segments.tr: - Cambien la forma en que se evalúa la propiedad

segments.src: - Set caps on government revenue or spending
segments.tr: - Establezcan límites a los ingresos o gastos del gobierno

segments.src: These measures can be hard to read because the wording is technical.
segments.tr: Estas medidas pueden ser difíciles de leer porque la redacción es técnica.

segments.src: A few practical questions help cut through it: Who pays more or less?
segments.tr: Unas cuantas preguntas prácticas ayudan a aclararlo: ¿Quién paga más o menos?

segments.src: What will the money fund?
segments.tr: ¿Qué financiará el dinero?

segments.src: Is the change temporary or permanent?
segments.tr: ¿Es el cambio temporal o permanente?

segments.src: Nonpartisan fiscal analyses, which many states publish in official voter guides, usually estimate the cost or savings.
segments.tr: Los análisis fiscales no partidistas, que muchos estados publican en las guías oficiales para votantes, suelen estimar el costo o los ahorros.

segments.tr: ## Aborto y salud reproductiva

segments.src: Jackson Women's Health Organization* returned the question of abortion regulation to the states, voters in a number of states have been asked to decide the issue directly.
segments.tr: Jackson Women's Health Organization* devolvió la cuestión de la regulación del aborto a los estados, a los votantes de varios estados se les ha pedido que decidan el asunto directamente.

segments.src: Some measures seek to add protections for abortion access to a state constitution.
segments.tr: Algunas medidas buscan añadir protecciones para el acceso al aborto en la constitución estatal.

segments.src: Others would preserve or add limits on when abortion is allowed.
segments.tr: Otras preservarían o añadirían límites sobre cuándo se permite el aborto.

segments.src: These are some of the most closely watched and emotionally charged measures on any ballot.
segments.tr: Estas son algunas de las medidas más vigiladas de cerca y cargadas emocionalmente en cualquier papeleta.

segments.src: Because many are constitutional amendments, the outcome can set rules that are difficult to change later.
segments.tr: Debido a que muchas son enmiendas constitucionales, el resultado puede establecer reglas que son difíciles de cambiar más adelante.

segments.src: Voters should read the full text carefully, since the legal definitions, such as the stage of pregnancy, exceptions for health or medical emergencies, and the role of state regulation, can differ significantly from one state to the next.
segments.tr: Los votantes deben leer el texto completo con atención, ya que las definiciones legales, como la etapa del embarazo, las excepciones por salud o emergencias médicas y el papel de la regulación estatal, pueden diferir significativamente de un estado a otro.

segments.src: ## Election rules and civic questions
segments.tr: ## Reglas electorales y cuestiones cívicas

segments.tr: Otra categoría en crecimiento involucra cómo funcionan las elecciones mismas.

segments.tr: - Requisitos de identificación de votantes

segments.tr: - Primarias abiertas o no partidistas

segments.tr: - Cómo se trazan los distritos congresionales o legislativos

segments.src: - Who is eligible to vote in local elections

segments.tr: - Cambios en cómo funciona el proceso de iniciativa popular

segments.src: Because these measures affect the system through which future decisions are made, they can have long-lasting effects well beyond a single election.
segments.tr: Debido a que estas medidas afectan el sistema a través del cual se toman futuras decisiones, pueden tener efectos duraderos mucho más allá de una sola elección.

segments.src: ## How to read a ballot measure like an informed voter
segments.tr: ## Cómo leer una medida electoral como un votante informado

segments.src: Ballot language can be confusing, and a "yes" vote does not always mean what intuition suggests.
segments.tr: El lenguaje de la papeleta puede ser confuso, y un voto "sí" no siempre significa lo que la intuición sugiere.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: Unos cuantos hábitos ayudan:

segments.src: 1. **Read the official summary and full text.** Your state's secretary of state or election office publishes both.
segments.tr: 1. **Lea el resumen oficial y el texto completo.** El secretario de estado u oficina electoral de su estado publica ambos.

segments.src: 2. **Check what a yes and a no vote actually do.** Some measures are written so that "yes" means keeping an existing law, while on others it means changing it.
segments.tr: 2. **Compruebe qué hacen realmente un voto a favor y uno en contra.** Algunas medidas están redactadas para que un "sí" signifique mantener una ley existente, mientras que en otras significa cambiarla.

segments.src: 3. **Look at the fiscal impact statement.** Nonpartisan analysts often estimate costs, savings or revenue effects.
segments.tr: 3. **Consulte la declaración de impacto fiscal.** Los analistas no partidistas suelen estimar los costos, ahorros o efectos en los ingresos.

segments.src: 4. **Find out who is funding the campaigns.** Campaign finance records are public and show which groups back or oppose a measure.
segments.tr: 4. **Averigüe quién está financiando las campañas.** Los registros de financiamiento de campañas son públicos y muestran qué grupos respaldan o se oponen a una medida.

segments.src: 5. **Compare several sources.** Reading local news coverage, nonpartisan voter guides and arguments from both sides gives a fuller picture than any one campaign message.
segments.tr: 5. **Compare varias fuentes.** Leer la cobertura de noticias locales, guías para votantes no partidistas y argumentos de ambos lados ofrece un panorama más completo que el mensaje de cualquier campaña individual.

segments.src: 6. **Note whether it is a statute or a constitutional amendment.** Amendments are generally harder to undo.
segments.tr: 6. **Observe si es un estatuto o una enmienda constitucional.** Las enmiendas son generalmente más difíciles de deshacer.

segments.src: 7. **Check the effective date.** Some measures take effect immediately; others phase in over years.
segments.tr: 7. **Verifique la fecha de entrada en vigor.** Algunas medidas entran en vigor de inmediato; otras se implementan gradualmente a lo largo de los años.

segments.src: ## Don't skip the bottom of the ballot
segments.tr: ## No se salte la parte inferior de la papeleta

segments.src: Studies of voting behavior have long shown that some voters stop filling out their ballots before they reach the ballot questions, a pattern known as "ballot roll-off."
segments.tr: Los estudios sobre el comportamiento de voto han demostrado durante mucho tiempo que algunos votantes dejan de llenar sus papeletas antes de llegar a las preguntas electorales, un patrón conocido como "abandono de la papeleta" (ballot roll-off).

segments.src: Yet these are often the places where a single vote has the most direct effect on policy.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, estos son a menudo los lugares donde un solo voto tiene el efecto más directo sobre las políticas.

segments.src: Before you vote, find your state's official voter guide, confirm your polling place or early voting options, and consider reviewing a sample ballot, which many election offices post online.
segments.tr: Antes de votar, busque la guía oficial para votantes de su estado, confirme su lugar de votación o sus opciones de votación anticipada, y considere revisar una papeleta de muestra, que muchas oficinas electorales publican en línea.

segments.src: A few minutes of preparation can make the difference between guessing and voting with confidence.
segments.tr: Unos minutos de preparación pueden marcar la diferencia entre adivinar y votar con confianza.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.src: Candidates matter, but so do the questions placed directly in voters' hands.
segments.tr: Los candidatos importan, pero también las preguntas puestas directamente en manos de los votantes.

segments.src: Whether the topic is pay, taxes, health care or the mechanics of democracy itself, ballot measures give residents a say in the rules they live under.
segments.tr: Ya sea que el tema sea el salario, los impuestos, la atención médica o la mecánica de la democracia misma, las medidas electorales dan a los residentes voz en las reglas bajo las cuales viven.

segments.src: Whatever your view, the most useful thing you can do is read the measure, understand what it would change, and make your choice.
segments.tr: Sea cual sea su opinión, lo más útil que puede hacer es leer la medida, entender qué cambiaría y tomar su decisión.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: 1. **اقرأ الملخص الرسمي والنص الكامل.** ينشر كل من سكرتير الولاية أو مكتب الانتخابات في ولايتك كلاهما.

segments.src: 1. **Read the official summary and full text.** Your state's secretary of state or election office publishes both.
segments.tr: 2. **تحقق مما يفعله التصويت بنعم ولاء فعلياً.** كُتبت بعض التدابير بحيث تعني "نعم" الاحتفاظ بقانون موجود، بينما تعني في حالات أخرى تغييره.

segments.src: 2. **Check what a yes and a no vote actually do.** Some measures are written so that "yes" means keeping an existing law, while on others it means changing it.
segments.tr: 3. **انظر إلى بيان التأثير المالي.** غالباً ما يقدر المحللون غير الحزبيين التكاليف أو المدخرات أو تأثيرات الإيرادات.

segments.src: 3. **Look at the fiscal impact statement.** Nonpartisan analysts often estimate costs, savings or revenue effects.
segments.tr: 4. **اعرف من يمول الحملات.** سجلات تمويل الحملات علنية وتوضح المجموعات التي تدعم مقترحاً ما أو تعارضه.

segments.src: 4. **Find out who is funding the campaigns.** Campaign finance records are public and show which groups back or oppose a measure.
segments.tr: 5. **قارن بين عدة مصادر.** قراءة التغطية الإخبارية المحلية وأدلة الناخبين غير الحزبية والحجج من الجانبين تعطي صورة أكمل من أي رسالة حملة واحدة.

segments.src: 5. **Compare several sources.** Reading local news coverage, nonpartisan voter guides and arguments from both sides gives a fuller picture than any one campaign message.
segments.tr: 6. **لاحظ ما إذا كان قانوناً أم تعديلاً دستورياً.** التعديلات عموماً أصعب في التراجع عنها.

segments.src: 6. **Note whether it is a statute or a constitutional amendment.** Amendments are generally harder to undo.
segments.tr: 7. **تحقق من تاريخ السريان.** تدخل بعض التدابير حيز التنفيذ فوراً؛ والبعض الآخر يتم تنفيذه تدريجياً على مدى سنوات.

segments.src: 7. **Check the effective date.** Some measures take effect immediately; others phase in over years.

fr.title: Au-delà des candidats : comment les mesures soumises aux électeurs pourraient modifier les salaires, les impôts et les règles sur l'avortement

segments.src: When voters head to the polls in the midterm elections, the names at the top of the ballot get most of the attention.
segments.tr: Lorsque les électeurs se rendent aux urnes lors des élections de mi-mandat, les noms en tête de liste retiennent le plus l'attention.

segments.src: But further down the page, many Americans will also be asked to decide ballot questions that can reshape everyday life in ways a single congressional seat rarely can.
segments.tr: Mais plus bas sur le bulletin, de nombreux Américains seront également invités à se prononcer sur des questions référendaires capables de transformer le quotidien d'une manière qu'un simple siège au Congrès parvient rarement à faire.

segments.src: Ballot measures, also called initiatives, referendums or propositions, let voters weigh in directly on state laws and constitutions.
segments.tr: Les référendums d'initiative populaire, également appelés initiatives, référendums ou propositions, permettent aux électeurs de peser directement sur les lois et les constitutions des États.

segments.src: Depending on the state, a measure may be placed on the ballot by citizen petition, by the legislature, or through a mix of both.
segments.tr: Selon l'État, une mesure peut être inscrite sur le bulletin de vote par pétition citoyenne, par l'organe législatif, ou par une combinaison des deux.

segments.src: If it passes, it can take effect without a governor's signature, and in some cases it changes the state constitution itself.
segments.tr: Si elle est adoptée, elle peut entrer en vigueur sans la signature du gouverneur et, dans certains cas, elle modifie la constitution de l'État elle-même.

segments.src: This guide explains why these measures matter, the main categories voters are likely to see, and how to prepare.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique pourquoi ces mesures comptent, les principales catégories que les électeurs sont susceptibles de rencontrer et la manière de se préparer.

segments.src: Because the lineup differs from state to state and can change before Election Day, always confirm the exact wording and status of each measure with your state's official election office.
segments.tr: Étant donné que la liste varie d'un État à l'autre et peut changer avant le jour du scrutin, confirmez toujours la formulation exacte et le statut de chaque mesure auprès du bureau électoral officiel de votre État.

segments.src: ## Why ballot measures matter
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les référendums d'initiative populaire sont importants

segments.src: A member of Congress is one of 435 voices in the House, and one of many shaping federal policy.
segments.tr: Un membre du Congrès n'est qu'une voix parmi 435 à la Chambre, et l'une des nombreuses personnes façonnant la politique fédérale.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, often decides a question outright.
segments.tr: Une mesure référendaire, en revanche, tranche souvent une question de manière définitive.

segments.src: A yes or no vote can:
segments.tr: Un vote par oui ou par non peut :

segments.src: - Change what an employer must pay a worker
segments.tr: - Modifier ce qu'un employeur doit verser à un travailleur

segments.src: - Alter how much residents owe in property, income or sales taxes
segments.tr: - Modifier le montant que les résidents doivent au titre des impôts fonciers, sur le revenu ou sur les ventes

segments.src: - Set the legal framework for health care decisions
segments.tr: - Fixer le cadre juridique des décisions en matière de soins de santé

segments.src: - Rewrite the rules for how elections are run
segments.tr: - Réécrire les règles régissant l'organisation des élections

segments.src: Because the effects are direct and local, the results can be felt quickly, sometimes within a few months of the vote.
segments.tr: Les effets étant directs et locaux, les résultats peuvent se faire sentir rapidement, parfois en l'espace de quelques mois suivant le vote.

segments.src: ## Minimum wage and workplace rules
segments.tr: ## Salaire minimum et règles sur le lieu de travail

segments.src: Wage measures are among the most common citizen-driven questions.
segments.tr: Les mesures salariales figurent parmi les questions d'initiative citoyenne les plus courantes.

segments.src: They typically ask voters to raise a state minimum wage to a set figure, often in steps over several years, or to tie future increases to inflation.
segments.tr: Elles demandent généralement aux électeurs d'augmenter le salaire minimum d'un État pour atteindre un chiffre déterminé, souvent de manière échelonnée sur plusieurs années, ou d'indexer les augmentations futures sur l'inflation.

segments.src: Some measures also address paid sick leave, tipped-worker pay or scheduling rules.
segments.tr: Certaines mesures abordent également le congé de maladie payé, la rémunération des travailleurs au pourboire ou les règles d'établissement des horaires.

segments.src: **What supporters usually argue:** Higher wage floors help workers keep up with rising living costs and reduce reliance on public assistance.
segments.tr: **Ce que les partisans avancent généralement :** Des planchers salariaux plus élevés aident les travailleurs à faire face à la hausse du coût de la vie et réduisent leur dépendance à l'égard de l'aide publique.

segments.src: **What opponents usually argue:** Higher labor costs can squeeze small businesses, leading to reduced hours, higher prices or fewer jobs, especially in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: **Ce que les opposants avancent généralement :** Des coûts de main-d'œuvre plus élevés peuvent peser sur les petites entreprises, entraînant une réduction des heures de travail, des prix plus élevés ou une diminution des emplois, en particulier dans les régions où le coût de la vie est plus bas.

segments.src: **What to look for:** the final wage figure, the timeline for increases, whether future raises are automatic, and whether the measure includes exceptions for small employers or certain job types.
segments.tr: **Ce qu'il faut rechercher :** le chiffre final du salaire, le calendrier des augmentations, le fait de savoir si les hausses futures sont automatiques et si la mesure prévoit des exceptions pour les petits employeurs ou certains types d'emplois.

segments.tr: Le libellé des bulletins de vote peut porter à confusion, et un vote « oui » ne signifie pas toujours ce que l'intuition suggère.

segments.src: Ballot language can be confusing, and a "yes" vote does not always mean what intuition suggests.
segments.tr: Quelques habitudes permettent d'y voir clair :

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: 1. **Lisez le résumé officiel et le texte intégral.** Le secrétaire d'État ou le bureau électoral de votre État publie les deux.

segments.src: 1. **Read the official summary and full text.** Your state's secretary of state or election office publishes both.
segments.tr: 2. **Vérifiez ce que font réellement un vote par oui et un vote par non.** Certaines mesures sont rédigées de telle sorte que « oui » signifie le maintien d'une loi existante, tandis que pour d'autres, cela signifie la modifier.

segments.src: 2. **Check what a yes and a no vote actually do.** Some measures are written so that "yes" means keeping an existing law, while on others it means changing it.
segments.tr: 3. **Examinez la déclaration d'impact budgétaire.** Des analystes non partisans estiment souvent les coûts, les économies ou les effets sur les recettes.

segments.src: 3. **Look at the fiscal impact statement.** Nonpartisan analysts often estimate costs, savings or revenue effects.
segments.tr: 4. **Découvrez qui finance les campagnes.** Les dossiers de financement de campagne sont publics et indiquent quels groupes soutiennent ou s'opposent à une mesure.

segments.src: 4. **Find out who is funding the campaigns.** Campaign finance records are public and show which groups back or oppose a measure.
segments.tr: 5. **Comparez plusieurs sources.** Lire la couverture de l'actualité locale, les guides électoraux non partisans et les arguments des deux camps donne une image plus complète que n'importe quel message de campagne.

segments.src: 5. **Compare several sources.** Reading local news coverage, nonpartisan voter guides and arguments from both sides gives a fuller picture than any one campaign message.
segments.tr: 6. **Notez s'il s'agit d'une loi statutaire ou d'un amendement constitutionnel.** Les amendements sont généralement plus difficiles à annuler.

segments.src: 6. **Note whether it is a statute or a constitutional amendment.** Amendments are generally harder to undo.
segments.tr: 7. **Vérifiez la date d'entrée en vigueur.** Certaines mesures prennent effet immédiatement ; d'autres sont échelonnées sur plusieurs années.

segments.src: 7. **Check the effective date.** Some measures take effect immediately; others phase in over years.
segments.tr: ## Ne négligez pas le bas du bulletin de vote

segments.src: ## Don't skip the bottom of the ballot
segments.tr: Des études sur le comportement électoral montrent depuis longtemps que certains électeurs cessent de remplir leur bulletin avant d'atteindre les questions référendaires, un schéma connu sous le nom de « déperdition des votes » (ballot roll-off).

segments.src: Studies of voting behavior have long shown that some voters stop filling out their ballots before they reach the ballot questions, a pattern known as "ballot roll-off."
segments.tr: Pourtant, c'est souvent là que le vote d'une seule personne a l'effet le plus direct sur les politiques.

segments.src: Yet these are often the places where a single vote has the most direct effect on policy.
segments.tr: Avant de voter, trouvez le guide officiel de l'électeur de votre État, confirmez votre bureau de vote ou vos options de vote anticipé, et envisagez de consulter un spécimen de bulletin de vote, que de nombreux bureaux électoraux publient en ligne.

segments.src: Before you vote, find your state's official voter guide, confirm your polling place or early voting options, and consider reviewing a sample ballot, which many election offices post online.
segments.tr: Quelques minutes de préparation peuvent faire la différence entre deviner et voter en toute confiance.

segments.src: A few minutes of preparation can make the difference between guessing and voting with confidence.
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: Les candidats ont leur importance, mais les questions soumises directement aux électeurs l'ont tout autant.

segments.src: Candidates matter, but so do the questions placed directly in voters' hands.
segments.tr: Qu'il s'agisse des salaires, des impôts, des soins de santé ou des mécanismes de la démocratie elle-même, les mesures référendaires permettent aux résidents d'avoir leur mot à dire sur les règles qui régissent leur vie.

segments.src: Whether the topic is pay, taxes, health care or the mechanics of democracy itself, ballot measures give residents a say in the rules they live under.
segments.tr: Quel que soit votre point de vue, la chose la plus utile à faire est de lire la mesure, de comprendre ce qu'elle modifierait et de faire votre choix.

segments.src: Whatever your view, the most useful thing you can do is read the measure, understand what it would change, and make your choice.

segments.src: Ballot measures, also called initiatives, referendums or propositions, let voters weigh in directly on state laws and constitutions.
segments.tr: As propostas de referendo, também chamadas de iniciativas, referendos ou proposições, permitem que os eleitores opinem diretamente sobre as leis e constituições estaduais.

segments.src: Depending on the state, a measure may be placed on the ballot by citizen petition, by the legislature, or through a mix of both.
segments.tr: Dependendo do estado, uma proposta pode ser colocada na cédula por petição dos cidadãos, pela legislatura ou por meio de uma combinação de ambos.

segments.src: If it passes, it can take effect without a governor's signature, and in some cases it changes the state constitution itself.
segments.tr: Se for aprovada, ela pode entrar em vigor sem a assinatura do governador e, em alguns casos, altera a própria constituição estadual.

segments.src: This guide explains why these measures matter, the main categories voters are likely to see, and how to prepare.

segments.tr: Como a lista difere de estado para estado e pode mudar antes do Dia da Eleição, sempre confirme a redação exata e o status de cada proposta no escritório eleitoral oficial do seu estado.

segments.src: ## Why ballot measures matter
segments.tr: ## Por que as propostas de referendo são importantes

segments.src: A member of Congress is one of 435 voices in the House, and one of many shaping federal policy.
segments.tr: Um membro do Congresso é uma das 435 vozes na Câmara e uma de muitas que moldam a política federal.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, often decides a question outright.
segments.tr: Uma proposta de referendo, em contrapartida, muitas vezes decide uma questão de forma direta.

segments.src: A yes or no vote can:
segments.tr: Um voto sim ou não pode:

segments.src: - Change what an employer must pay a worker
segments.tr: - Mudar o que um empregador deve pagar a um trabalhador

segments.src: - Alter how much residents owe in property, income or sales taxes
segments.tr: - Alterar o valor que os residentes devem em impostos sobre a propriedade, renda ou vendas

segments.src: - Set the legal framework for health care decisions
segments.tr: - Estabelecer a estrutura legal para decisões de saúde

segments.src: - Rewrite the rules for how elections are run
segments.tr: - Reescrever as regras de como as eleições são realizadas

segments.src: Because the effects are direct and local, the results can be felt quickly, sometimes within a few months of the vote.
segments.tr: Como os efeitos são diretos e locais, os resultados podem ser sentidos rapidamente, às vezes dentro de alguns meses após a votação.

segments.src: ## Minimum wage and workplace rules
segments.tr: ## Salário mínimo e regras de trabalho

segments.src: Wage measures are among the most common citizen-driven questions.
segments.tr: As propostas salariais estão entre as questões mais comuns impulsionadas pelos cidadãos.

segments.src: They typically ask voters to raise a state minimum wage to a set figure, often in steps over several years, or to tie future increases to inflation.
segments.tr: Elas normalmente pedem aos eleitores que aumentem o salário mínimo estadual para um valor definido, geralmente em etapas ao longo de vários anos, ou que vinculem aumentos futuros à inflação.

segments.src: Some measures also address paid sick leave, tipped-worker pay or scheduling rules.
segments.tr: Algumas propostas também abordam licença médica remunerada, remuneração de trabalhadores que recebem gorjetas ou regras de agendamento.

segments.src: **What supporters usually argue:** Higher wage floors help workers keep up with rising living costs and reduce reliance on public assistance.
segments.tr: **O que os defensores geralmente argumentam:** Pisos salariais mais altos ajudam os trabalhadores a acompanhar o aumento do custo de vida e reduzem a dependência de assistência pública.

segments.src: **What opponents usually argue:** Higher labor costs can squeeze small businesses, leading to reduced hours, higher prices or fewer jobs, especially in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: **O que os opositores geralmente argumentam:** Custos de trabalho mais altos podem espremer pequenas empresas, levando a horas reduzidas, preços mais altos ou menos empregos, especialmente em regiões de menor custo.

segments.src: **What to look for:** the final wage figure, the timeline for increases, whether future raises are automatic, and whether the measure includes exceptions for small employers or certain job types.
segments.tr: **O que procurar:** o valor salarial final, o cronograma para aumentos, se os futuros aumentos são automáticos e se a proposta inclui exceções para pequenos empregadores ou certos tipos de trabalho.

segments.src: ## Taxes and public spending
segments.tr: ## Impostos e gastos públicos

segments.src: Tax questions come in many forms.
segments.tr: As questões fiscais vêm em muitas formas.

segments.src: Voters may be asked to:
segments.tr: Os eleitores podem ser convidados a:

segments.tr: - Aumentar ou cortar impostos estaduais de renda, propriedade ou vendas

segments.tr: - Aprovar títulos para financiar escolas, estradas ou moradia

segments.src: - Create or limit taxes on high earners

segments.src: - Change how property is assessed

segments.src: - Set caps on government revenue or spending
segments.tr: - Estabelecer limites para a receita ou gastos do governo

segments.src: These measures can be hard to read because the wording is technical.
segments.tr: Essas propostas podem ser difíceis de ler porque a linguagem é técnica.

segments.src: A few practical questions help cut through it: Who pays more or less?

segments.src: What will the money fund?

segments.src: Is the change temporary or permanent?

segments.src: Because the effects are direct and local, the results can be felt quickly, sometimes within a few months of the vote.
segments.tr: Karena efeknya bersifat langsung dan lokal, hasilnya dapat dirasakan dengan cepat, terkadang dalam beberapa bulan setelah pemungutan suara.

segments.src: ## Minimum wage and workplace rules
segments.tr: ## Upah minimum dan aturan tempat kerja

segments.src: Wage measures are among the most common citizen-driven questions.
segments.tr: Langkah-langkah upah adalah salah satu pertanyaan yang paling sering didorong oleh warga.

segments.src: They typically ask voters to raise a state minimum wage to a set figure, often in steps over several years, or to tie future increases to inflation.
segments.tr: Mereka biasanya meminta pemilih untuk menaikkan upah minimum negara bagian ke angka tertentu, sering kali secara bertahap selama beberapa tahun, atau mengaitkan kenaikan di masa mendatang dengan inflasi.

segments.src: Some measures also address paid sick leave, tipped-worker pay or scheduling rules.
segments.tr: Beberapa langkah juga membahas cuti sakit berbayar, bayaran pekerja yang menerima tip, atau aturan penjadwalan.

segments.src: **What supporters usually argue:** Higher wage floors help workers keep up with rising living costs and reduce reliance on public assistance.
segments.tr: **Apa yang biasanya dikemukakan pendukung:** Batas bawah upah yang lebih tinggi membantu pekerja mengejar kenaikan biaya hidup dan mengurangi ketergantungan pada bantuan publik.

segments.src: **What opponents usually argue:** Higher labor costs can squeeze small businesses, leading to reduced hours, higher prices or fewer jobs, especially in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: **Apa yang biasanya dikemukakan penentang:** Biaya tenaga kerja yang lebih tinggi dapat menekan bisnis kecil, yang mengarah pada pengurangan jam kerja, harga yang lebih tinggi, atau lebih sedikit pekerjaan, terutama di wilayah dengan biaya lebih rendah.

segments.src: **What to look for:** the final wage figure, the timeline for increases, whether future raises are automatic, and whether the measure includes exceptions for small employers or certain job types.
segments.tr: **Yang harus dicari:** angka upah akhir, jadwal kenaikan, apakah kenaikan di masa mendatang bersifat otomatis, dan apakah tindakan tersebut menyertakan pengecualian untuk pemberi kerja kecil atau jenis pekerjaan tertentu.

segments.src: ## Taxes and public spending
segments.tr: ## Pajak dan pengeluaran publik

segments.src: Tax questions come in many forms.
segments.tr: Pertanyaan pajak datang dalam berbagai bentuk.

segments.src: Voters may be asked to:
segments.tr: Pemilih mungkin diminta untuk:

segments.src: - Raise or cut state income, property or sales taxes
segments.tr: - Menaikkan atau memotong pajak penghasilan, properti, atau penjualan negara bagian

segments.src: - Approve bonds to fund schools, roads or housing
segments.tr: - Menyetujui obligasi untuk mendanai sekolah, jalan, atau perumahan

segments.src: - Create or limit taxes on high earners
segments.tr: - Membuat atau membatasi pajak bagi berpenghasilan tinggi

segments.src: - Change how property is assessed
segments.tr: - Mengubah cara properti dinilai

segments.src: - Set caps on government revenue or spending
segments.tr: - Menetapkan batasan pendapatan atau pengeluaran pemerintah

segments.src: These measures can be hard to read because the wording is technical.
segments.tr: Langkah-langkah ini bisa sulit dibaca karena kata-katanya bersifat teknis.

segments.src: A few practical questions help cut through it: Who pays more or less?
segments.tr: Beberapa pertanyaan praktis membantu memahaminya: Siapa yang membayar lebih banyak atau lebih sedikit?

segments.src: What will the money fund?
segments.tr: Untuk apa uang itu akan digunakan?

segments.src: Is the change temporary or permanent?
segments.tr: Apakah perubahan itu bersifat sementara atau permanen?

segments.src: Nonpartisan fiscal analyses, which many states publish in official voter guides, usually estimate the cost or savings.

segments.src: Because many are constitutional amendments, the outcome can set rules that are difficult to change later.

segments.src: Voters should read the full text carefully, since the legal definitions, such as the stage of pregnancy, exceptions for health or medical emergencies, and the role of state regulation, can differ significantly from one state to the next.

segments.src: ## Election rules and civic questions
segments.tr: ## Aturan pemilu dan pertanyaan kewarganegaraan

segments.tr: - Pemilihan pendahuluan terbuka atau nonpartisan

segments.src: - How congressional or legislative districts are drawn

segments.src: Because these measures affect the system through which future decisions are made, they can have long-lasting effects well beyond a single election.
